title: MCC Four Winds and Maui Magic Snorkel Tour Boats
gap: Age minimum for Four Winds Molokini Crater and Coral Gardens tours not explicitly stated
blurb: Guests snorkel inside Molokini Crater or at Coral Gardens, swim with tropical fish and green sea turtles, and enjoy seasonal whale watching. The Four Winds offers a glass-bottom viewing room and kid-friendly amenities. Tours include meals, open bar, and optional SNUBA experience.
